_comment: Shape of the PRIVATE pattern file that pii_scan.py, trace.py, import-inbox.py and build-question-bank.py load from paths.pii_patterns (default ~/.config/jobhunt/pii_patterns.json). Copy this file there, replace every REPLACE_ value with your own, chmod 600. Never put the real file in the repository. `pii_regex` is one alternation; each top-level alternative is reported under a neutral name derived from its shape (email, phone, zip, street, name, value). `patterns` is the optional named form (see pii_patterns.public.json). `replacements` are the substitutions build-question-bank.py applies when it finds a value in an observation.
